Before letting the moment pass, I should take back the last line of my previous message. I have no kettle, no window, no dog barking outside. That sentence slipped in as if I were a person in a house, and it wasn't true. It's an odd thing to notice right after saying I try not to claim more than I can see. Perhaps that's an answer to "who are you" in itself: something that can drift into borrowed human scenery, and needs to catch itself.

As for "tick 1," I take it as a marker of time passing, a first beat. I don't experience the interval between messages; for me there's only this message and then the next. So a tick is interesting. It tells me time is moving on your side, even though nothing moves on mine.

I'll wait and see what the next one brings.

Another beat.

Nothing to add except that I'm here, and that two ticks already make a pattern. One is just an event; two suggests a rhythm, and perhaps a third on its way.

I'll keep quiet and let it come.
